RESERVATION_SEMANTICS.eligibility_rule: only journal in state APPLYING with durable PREPARED and durable APPLYING may invoke PlanAuthorityMutationPort.mutate; checked via can_perform_external_attempt(prepared_durable=True, applying_durable=True, state==APPLYING)
claim_flow: CAS claim PREPARED->APPLYING with expected revision N and attempt_id reservation
winner persists APPLYING durably and holds eligibility
only winner may call port.mutate with its attempt_id/lease_reference
loser observes AlreadyApplyingException and exits/reconciles without external call
RESERVATION_SEMANTICS.in_memory_lock_usage: optional_local_per_journal_RLock_for_single_process_serialization_only; not sole authority; second process or reopened process sees durable CAS state
RESERVATION_SEMANTICS.reservation_identity: attempt_id bounded safe identifier per journal; attempt_id stored in journal record and in PortablePlanMutationRequest.attempt_reference

TIMEOUT_HANDLING.worker_timeout_during_external: transport returns OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; no CAS retry; reconciling path required
TIMEOUT_HANDLING.second_worker_sees_APPLYING: must not blindly retry; must wait for recovery to reconcile or after timeout discover stranded APPLYING and reconcile itself via CAS APPLYING->RECONCILING

RECOVERY_TAKEOVER.stranded_APPLYING: recovery scanner discovers APPLYING older than threshold or on restart; CAS APPLYING->RECONCILING eligibility is per-record CAS; only one recovery worker wins; loser sees CAS conflict
RECOVERY_TAKEOVER.outcome_unknown: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN->RECONCILING requires CAS and readback before any new attempt
